gaps: The plan uses the closest available library case and does not specifically perform two add_response operations of 60 followed by 60 on a quantity of 100.
warnings: error code 561 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot select bid with more than requested quantity.”, and never with a server error.
